querySettings.query:
SELECT
    cf$_invoice_date                                          AS invoice_date,
    cf$_customer_code                                         AS customer,
    SUM(cf$_weight)                                           AS weight,
    decode(cf$_item_type, 'SOLID', 'ST1', 'PNEUMATIC', 'ST3') AS bu,
    cf$_brand                                                 AS itembrand,
    SUM(cf$_usd_val_ori_cus)                                  AS usd_value,
    null as InventoryID
FROM
    ifsapp.dwc_invoices_data_bi_clt
WHERE
    cf$_invoice_date > '01-May-2023'
GROUP BY
    cf$_customer_code,
    cf$_invoice_date,
    cf$_item_type,
    cf$_brand
UNION ALL
SELECT
    a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer                                         AS customer,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_weight)                                             AS weight,
    decode(a.cf$_c_com_item_type, 'Solid', 'ST1', 'Pneumatic', 'ST3') AS bu,
    a.cf$_brand_description                                           AS itembrand,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_dom_amount)                                         AS usd_value,
    a.CATALOG_NO as InventoryID
FROM
    ifsapp.customer_order_inv_join_cfv a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ifsinfo.dwc_active_prices   b ON a.cf$_c_shipment_customer = b.customer_no
                                                   AND a.catalog_no = b.catalog_no
WHERE
        a.company = 'GRISL'
    AND a.client_state NOT IN ( 'Cancelled', 'Preliminary' )
    AND a.cf$_weight IS NOT NULL
    AND a.cf$_c_shipment_customer <> 'CS0286'
    AND a.series_id NOT IN ( (
        SELECT
            a.series_id
        FROM
            ifsapp.customer_order_inv_join_cfv
        WHERE
                a.series_id = 'CR'
            AND a.cf$_shipment_id IS NOT NULL
    ) )
    AND a.invoice_date > '01-May-2023'
    AND cf$_country = 'SRI LANKA'
    
GROUP BY
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer,
    a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_com_item_type,
    a.cf$_brand_description, a.CATALOG_NO
    
UNION ALL

select
 a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer                                         AS customer,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_weight)                                             AS weight,
    decode(a.cf$_c_com_item_type, 'Solid', 'ST1', 'Pneumatic', 'ST3') AS bu,
    a.cf$_brand_description                                           AS itembrand,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_dom_amount)                                         AS usd_value,
    a.CATALOG_NO as InventoryID
 
 
from ifsapp.CUSTOMER_ORDER_INV_JOIN_CFV a
where 
a.COMPANY = 'DWCLLC' and a.CONTRACT = 'DWC50' and
a.CF$_ITEM_TYPE is not null and a.SERIES_ID = 'CD' and a.IDENTITY not in ('CS0286','CS0193','CS0197')
AND a.invoice_date > '31-Mar-2025'

GROUP BY
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer,
    a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_com_item_type,
    a.cf$_brand_description, a.CATALOG_NO
    
UNION ALL

select
 a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer                                         AS customer,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_weight)                                             AS weight,
    decode(a.cf$_c_com_item_type, 'Solid', 'ST1', 'Pneumatic', 'ST3') AS bu,
    a.cf$_brand_description                                           AS itembrand,
    SUM(a.cf$_net_dom_amount)                                         AS usd_value,
    a.CATALOG_NO as InventoryID
 
 
from ifsapp.CUSTOMER_ORDER_INV_JOIN_CFV a
where 
a.COMPANY = 'GRISL' and a.CONTRACT = 'GRI01' and
a.CF$_ITEM_TYPE is not null and a.SERIES_ID = 'CD' and ifsapp.shipment_api.Get_Ship_Addr_No(a.CF$_SHIPMENT_ID) = 'CS0084'  
AND a.invoice_date > '31-Mar-2025'

GROUP BY
    a.cf$_c_shipment_customer,
    a.invoice_date,
    a.cf$_c_com_item_type,
    a.cf$_brand_description, a.CATALOG_NO
